home.title: AuthSteem
home.heroTitle: You're in control of your keys.
home.heroDescription: With AuthSteem, you're always in control of your private keys: we neither store nor have access to them.
home.importOrLogin: Import an account or log in to get started.

login.title: Login
login.description: Unlock an account from your keychain
login.errorRequired: Username and keychain password are required.
login.savedAccountsDescription: Encrypted keys stored in this browser. Removing an account only deletes local data.
login.removeConfirmDescription: Remove @{{username}} from this browser? Your Steem account on the blockchain is not affected. You can import again later.

import.title: Import account
import.description: Add an account using username + password or a private key (WIF)
import.usernameHint: Your Steem blockchain account name (e.g. alice).
import.passwordHint: Your account password, or a private key in WIF format (starts with 5...). Used to derive signing keys; we never send it to any server.
import.keychainPasswordHint: A password you choose to encrypt your keys in this browser. Remember it — you will need it to unlock the account when signing. Minimum 8 characters.
import.keychainConfirmHint: Re-enter the keychain password to confirm.
import.errorRequired: Username and password (or private key) are required.
import.errorKeyMismatch: Keychain password and confirmation must match.
import.errorKeyLength: Keychain password must be at least 8 characters.
import.errorKeychainStrength: Keychain password is too weak. Use at least 8 characters with both letters and numbers.
import.errorAuthority: You need to use master or {{authority}} key.

sign.title: Confirm transaction
sign.callbackNotice: You will be redirected after signing.
sign.loginDialogDescription: Log in to review and sign this transaction.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.signPlaceholder: Paste Steem URI signing data here (e.g. steem://sign/ops/...)

broadcastOp.title: Broadcast Op Test
broadcastOp.description: Dev tool to build a signing link for an operation and open it in a new tab.

steemUriTest.title: Steem URI Test
steemUriTest.description: Convert between ops (JSON array) and steem:// URI.

devTools.indexDescription: Developer utilities for Steem signing and URI handling.

home.title: AuthSteem
home.heroDescription: 使用 AuthSteem，您的私钥始终由您自己掌控：我们不会存储也无法访问您的私钥。
home.importOrLogin: 导入账户或登录以开始使用。

login.title: 登录
login.errorRequired: 用户名和钥匙串密码为必填项。
login.errorNotFound: 未在钥匙串中找到该账户。
login.errorInvalid: 钥匙串密码或凭证无效。
login.savedAccountsDescription: 密钥已加密保存在本浏览器中。移除仅删除本地数据。
login.removeConfirmDescription: 从本浏览器移除 @{{username}}？链上 Steem 账户不受影响，之后可重新导入。

import.title: 导入账户
import.description: 使用用户名 + 密码或私钥 (WIF) 添加账户
import.usernameHint: 您的 Steem 链上账户名（例如 alice）。
import.passwordHint: 您的账户密码，或 WIF 格式的私钥（以 5 开头）。用于派生签名密钥，我们不会将其发送到任何服务器。
import.keychainPasswordHint: 您设置的、用于在本浏览器中加密密钥的密码。请牢记，签名解锁账户时需要输入。至少 8 个字符。
import.keychainConfirmHint: 请再次输入钥匙串密码以确认。
import.errorRequired: 用户名和密码（或私钥）为必填项。
import.errorKeyMismatch: 钥匙串密码和确认密码必须一致。
import.errorKeyLength: 钥匙串密码至少为 8 个字符。
import.errorKeychainStrength: 钥匙串密码强度不足，请使用至少 8 个字符并同时包含字母和数字。
import.errorAuthority: 您需要使用主密钥或 {{authority}} 密钥。
